summary: The registrant filed an 8-K regarding a First Amendment to its existing Stockholder Rights Agreement (poison pill), extending the expiration date from July 31, 2026 to July 31, 2029. No other terms, consideration, premium, or shareholder vote are involved. This is a routine extension of a defensive rights plan, not a special situation transaction. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing solely updates the rights agreement's term, which is a governance maintenance item without triggering event-driven analysis.
